g.text: Task accuracy by model (task solved only when all 3 runs are correct)
Accuracy = tasks solved ÷ tasks (BixBench-Verified-50: 50; CompBioBench: 100; IWC: 10); a model solves a task when all 3 of its runs are correct (IWC runs: ≥ 0.99 agreement).
Bars: 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals (20,000 resamples; clusters are BixBench source capsules, otherwise tasks). Brackets: Galaxy vs custom code for each model,
paired cluster sign-flip test on tasks solved (200,000 draws; exact for IWC), Holm-adjusted over the 12 model comparisons: * adj. P < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001, ns not significant.

† The 95% interval excludes zero but the test does not reject. With few clusters that differ between the conditions, the percentile bootstrap is too narrow; significance rests on the exact sign-flip test.
